title: Job mutex via conditional DynamoDB PutItem
description:
## Behavior
```gherkin
Feature: Job claim mutex
  Scenario: First claimer wins
    Given a pending job with content_hash H
    When worker A and worker B both PUT /jobs/H/claim
    Then exactly one receives success
    And the job status becomes claimed with claim_owner and claim_deadline
  Scenario: Stale claim can be reclaimed
    Given a claimed job whose claim_deadline is in the past
    When a worker PUT /jobs/H/claim
    Then the claim succeeds and ownership transfers
```

## Implementation brief
1. cdk/stacks/backend.py: DynamoDB table AuritusJobs PK=content_hash.
2. API Gateway HTTP API route PUT /jobs/{hash}/claim with direct DynamoDB PutItem ConditionExpression: attribute_not_exists(#s) OR #s = :pending OR ( #s = :claimed AND claim_deadline < :now ).
3. Acceptance: unit/integration test with moto or local DynamoDB proves single winner.
